text:
Mika: Quick pulse — can we shift the June onboarding workshop to a bigger window? EMEA customers keep asking for a 16:00 UTC slot.
Jamal: +1 for 16:00 UTC. What dates are we looking at?
Mika: Thinking week of June 9. Main ask: a combined office hours + fidelity workshop for 3 high-risk accounts (NovaCare, LumenHealth, HelixThera). They need dedicated migration walk-throughs and billing clarity.
Sofia: I can host the EMEA-friendly 16:00 slot on June 10. Can Elaine cover dedicated migration checklist?
Elaine: Yep. I can run the migration checklist and a short demo (20m). Need someone for Q&A re: quant and perf.
Mika: @Sofia can run Q&A w/ perf summary. Agenda draft:
```
- 10m: Welcome + agenda
- 20m: Dedicated migration checklist (Elaine)
- 15m: Cost & perf primer + batching tips (Sofia)
- 10m: Onboarding playbook & success milestones (Mika)
- 15m: Open Q&A / account-specific breakouts
```
Jamal: Also capture renewal risk flags: NovaCare blocked on HIPAA onboarding docs, LumenHealth needs a dedicated trainer, HelixThera worried about latency SLAs.
Sofia: I'll add a slide for renewal flags and next steps. Also suggest sending a short pre-read to accounts (1 pager) — reduces session time.
Mika: Good call. Can someone own the pre-read? Elaine?
Elaine: I can draft the migration + perf half. Sofia can do the renewal risk one.
Mika: Who can do invites + calendar slots? Need to block: 2025-06-10 16:00-17:15 UTC (90m).
Jamal: I can create cal invites for the 3 accounts and internal ops. Need the customer contact list.
Sofia: I'll DM the contact list + permissions.
Mika: Also capture feedback: quick NPS 3-question survey post-session. Suggest we send link in follow-up with requested action items per account.
Elaine: +1. I have a simple Google form template we can reuse.
oncall-bot: Reminder — check dedicated GPU pool capacity for Jun 10 at 16:00 UTC. Current reserved utilization = 82%.
Mika: Thanks — @oncall-bot can you escalate if reserved capacity > 90% by Jun 8?
oncall-bot: Ack. I will post an update in #eng-sre if threshold crossed.
Sofia: Next steps list:
- [ ] Elaine draft slides (due Jun 3)
- [ ] Sofia pre-read + renewal slide (due Jun 4)
- [ ] Jamal send invites (due Jun 5)
- [ ] Mika compile account action items (during session)
Mika: Sounds good. If no objections I'll lock the slot tomorrow.
Elaine: No objections from me :thumbsup: 
Jamal: All good.
Sofia: All set :raised_hands: 
Mika: Thanks team — quick sync tomorrow 09:30 PT to finalize materials.
